# U2Tool - Free Online Developer Tools

> U2Tool provides 370+ free, browser-based developer tools. All processing happens locally in your browser - no data is sent to servers, ensuring complete privacy.

## Quick Facts

- Website: https://www.u2tool.com
- Tools Available: 370+
- Languages Supported: 10 (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Arabic)
- Data Privacy: 100% client-side processing, no server uploads
- Cost: Completely free, no registration required
- Last Updated: 2026-01-12

## Tool Categories

### Text & String Tools
- JSON Formatter: Format, validate, beautify, and minify JSON data
- Base64 Encoder/Decoder: Convert text and files to/from Base64
- URL Encoder/Decoder: Encode/decode URL components and query strings
- Word Counter: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs with real-time analysis
- Markdown Preview: Live preview Markdown with syntax highlighting and export options
- Text Case Converter: Convert between uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case
- Lorem Ipsum Generator: Generate placeholder text for design and development

### Generators
- UUID Generator: Generate RFC 4122 compliant UUIDs (v1, v4, v7)
- Password Generator: Create cryptographically secure passwords with customizable rules
- QR Code Generator: Generate QR codes from text, URLs, or data with customization
- Hash Generator: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes for text and files
- Random Number Generator: Generate random numbers with various distributions
- Fake Data Generator: Generate realistic test data for development

### Converters
- Color Converter: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK color formats
- Timestamp Converter: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa
- Unit Converter: Convert between measurement units (length, weight, temperature, etc.)
- Number Base Converter: Convert between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal
- Image Format Converter: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF formats

### Developer Tools
- Regex Tester: Test regular expressions with real-time matching and explanation
- SQL Formatter: Format and beautify SQL queries with syntax highlighting
- Code Minifier: Minify JavaScript, CSS, HTML code for production
- Diff Checker: Compare texts and highlight differences line by line
- JWT Decoder: Decode and inspect JWT tokens without the secret key
- XML Formatter: Format and validate XML documents
- YAML to JSON: Convert between YAML and JSON formats

### Security Tools
- Hash Generator: Generate secure hashes using various algorithms
- Password Strength Checker: Analyze password security and get improvement suggestions
- Encryption Tools: Encrypt and decrypt text using AES, DES, and other algorithms

### Image Tools
- Image Compressor: Compress images while maintaining quality
- Image to Base64: Convert images to Base64 encoded strings
- Color Picker: Pick colors from images or create custom palettes
- QR Code Scanner: Scan and decode QR codes from images

### Math & Calculators
- Percentage Calculator: Calculate percentages, increases, and decreases
- Loan Calculator: Calculate loan payments and amortization schedules
- Unit Price Calculator: Compare prices per unit for shopping decisions
- Scientific Calculator: Perform complex mathematical calculations

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is my data safe when using U2Tool?
A: Yes, absolutely. All tools run entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your data never leaves your device and is never sent to any server. This is our core privacy commitment.

Q: Do I need to create an account to use the tools?
A: No, all tools are immediately accessible without registration, login, or payment. Just visit the website and start using any tool instantly.

Q: What browsers are supported?
A: All modern browsers are fully supported, including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera. We recommend using the latest version for the best experience.

Q: Can I use U2Tool offline?
A: Most tools work offline once the page is loaded, since all processing happens in your browser. However, you need an internet connection to initially load the tools.

Q: Are the tools free to use commercially?
A: Yes, all tools are completely free for both personal and commercial use. There are no hidden fees or premium tiers.

Q: How accurate are the conversion and calculation tools?
A: Our tools use industry-standard algorithms and are regularly tested for accuracy. For critical applications, we recommend verifying results with multiple sources.

## Technical Information

- Framework: Next.js 14 with App Router
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Internationalization: next-intl supporting 10 languages
- Hosting: Vercel Edge Network
- Performance: Optimized for Core Web Vitals
